What are you doing Friday morning? Join Mary L Trump, Katie Phang and me Friday morning at 9:30 ET as we hash out the events of the last week. Lots to discuss in this special Substack Live, including John Roberts’ recent comments, regretting that Americans view the Justices as political actors. I think we’ll have a lot to say about that. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…
John Roberts is concerned Americans see the justices as political actors. He should read his own words. More here: joycevance.substack.com/p/th…

When Justices jump from saying this👇🏼 in 2023 to allow allowing openly racist gerrymanders, Americans who are paying attention can’t be blamed for viewing certain justices as political actors. Read more here: joycevance.substack.com/p/the-new-ji...

This informative update on the impact of the SCOTUS decision - not just in Alabama. Please read to the end of this - a warning about federal judges being appointed now. 
Please note: the ballroom is not being built for the “next guy”.
If you think it’s just the Deep South, please read this. We can’t afford to tell ourselves the myth that it’s going to be okay.

Or maybe, just hear me out, Americans are paying more attention to the Supreme Court than they used to, and they understand the difference between this Court and earlier ones where justices respected precedent.
“We have no choice but to overturn the 20th century”
